👨‍⚕️ Professional Help

When to Seek Professional Support

A therapist or counselor can provide personalized treatment. Consider seeking professional help if you're experiencing:

  • Persistent anxiety or panic attacks
  • Difficulty with daily activities
  • Thoughts of self-harm
  • Unprocessed trauma
  • Any crisis situation

📚 Reading List

Recommended Books

  • "The Anxiety and Phobia Workbook" by Edmund J. Bourne - Practical exercises for managing anxiety
  • "What Happened to You?" by Bruce D. Perry and Oprah Winfrey - Understanding trauma
  • "The Body Keeps the Score" by Bessel van der Kolk - Trauma and recovery
  • "Feeling Good" by David D. Burns - Cognitive behavioral techniques

Remember

Recovery is not linear. Progress is not always visible. Be patient and compassionate with yourself. Every small step forward is worth celebrating. You deserve support and healing.
